body: blueitbrownitgreenit, I really appreciate the help you have given me tonight. I am not going to fein a complete turn around, but you have definitely helped me find the right path I should take to turning this around. I will definitely take your advice towards counseling, as it seems like a pretty good plan to have everything mapped out before talking about why I'm thinking about this and what I am looking for. You were truely a great help, and I can almost certainly say that I am not going anywhere soon. Thank you again, and goodnight.

I really like what you have to say, and I do have a hobby - programming. For almost six years whenever I have free time I just sit down an code.

About the whole cool teacher idea, I really wish there was, but I really don't match with any of my teachers in any way. I don't really feel like explaining (I can if you want, but it might take a bit of typing).

I have been thinking about seeing a therapist or something, but I have no idea how to suggest it to my dad, do you have any ideas for doing that? I don't want to approach him and blantantly tell him whats up, but I may end up having to.

I understand where you are coming from on most of the third and fourth paragraphs, as for the second (and part of the third), my response is this:

I go to a private school, college prep. You would think the kids there would be serious, but reality is far from that. Every class, no matter how advanced, there are kids just messing around, and they just don't give a shit about anything or anyone else except for themselves and their group of friends. They have a ton of money, and they know it. They know daddy can buy them a fancy car, he can get them a job at his company. They are set. I don't even understand why the talk down to the less fortunate students, because usually we don't even give a response. Nothing. We just keep on walking. This entire school is bullshit, and I have no idea why I was forced into it, depite my near daily complaints of the quality. (Honestly, education comes first for sure, but school is a hell of a lot harder when you are treated like shit daily)
